tools.name: find_business
tools.description: Find salons, barbershops, spas and studios that take online bookings on Belcome, by name, service or city. Returns up to 10 businesses with their locations and booking page.

tools.name: list_services
tools.description: List the services a business offers online at one location: name, duration, price and the professionals who do each one. Use the ids with find_slots.

tools.name: find_slots
tools.description: Find open times for one service at a business, up to 14 days. Each time comes with a booking_url that opens the business's booking page with the service, professional and time already chosen; give that link to the person to confirm with their name and phone.

tools.name: get_business
tools.description: Opening hours, phone, address, map point, languages, rating, links and frequently asked questions of one business location. Use it for "is it open on Sunday?" or "what is the phone number?" before or after find_slots.

tools.name: list_team
tools.description: The professionals who take online bookings at a business location: name, role, short bio, the services each one does and their rating. Use the staff_id with find_slots to book with a specific person.

tools.name: list_reviews
tools.description: The average rating and the latest client reviews of a business location, as shown on its booking page. Empty when the business does not collect reviews.

tools.name: list_offers
tools.description: Session packages and memberships a business sells online, and whether it sells gift cards, with prices. Give the person shop_url to buy: payment happens there, never in the chat.

tools.name: get_booking_policy
tools.description: Cancellation window, whether the business approves bookings, how far ahead one can book, deposit or prepayment and late-cancel or no-show fees. Use it for "can I cancel?", "do I pay a deposit?" before handing over booking_url.

tools.name: get_about
tools.description: What the business says about itself on its booking page: tagline, "about us" story, studio policies (late arrival, parking, what to bring) and extra text blocks. Use it for "what is this place like?" or "what should I know before I go?".

tools.name: list_gallery
tools.description: The photos the business shows on its booking page (its work: cuts, colour, nails, tattoos...), each with the service it is tagged to and a booking link for that service. Use it for "can I see their work?" or "do they do this style?".

tools.name: list_addons
tools.description: Add-ons a business offers online at one location (a treatment extra, a longer session): name, duration, price and the services each one can be added to. They are picked on the booking page together with the main service, never booked alone.
